I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this field because one bag costs too much and my old legs cannot carry it from Mtwara town. I will spread two cartloads of manure from my goats and chickens here before the rains, and I will plant the maize seed I saved from last year. We will pull the weeds by hand and wait for the rains; I do not use chemicals or irrigation. My family will work about sixty-five days on this plot, and I will pay two young men from the village for eight days when the hoe work is hardest.
